learning_outcomes.text: Be familiar with the basic concepts of vector calculus as well as the differential and integral calculus applied in many dimensions.
Be able to apply these mathematical skills to solve problems arising in physical sciences and engineering.
Formulating and analyzing problems in geometry and physics by the methods of mathematical analysis

syllabus_topics: Vector calculus. Scalar and vector product. Triple products. Gradient, divergence, continuity equation, curl, product rules, second derivatives, Laplacian, vector integration, integral theorems (Gauss,Green,Stokes’s).
Spherical and cylindrical polar coordinates. Differential vector operations. Integration.

Linear algebra. Vector operations and geometry in 2 and 3 dimensions. Linear transformations and matrices. Trace and determinant. Properties of determinants. Systems of linear equations. Homogeneous systems. Eigenvalue equation and its geometrical significance. Characteristic polynomial. Calculation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Diagonalization.
teaching_methods: Use of the department's asynchronous training platform (e-class) for lecture notes, exercises, questionnaires, computer tools, recording of lectures
